full_prompt_en: A highly detailed surreal illustration presents a floating island against a pale gray-beige background. The island's upper surface is broad and nearly level, with green vegetation, small buildings, and a blue waterway running across the front. A large leafy tree rises toward the left, its dark trunk branching beneath a rounded canopy. Another cluster of trees stands on the right. Between them, a slender, angular tower extends into a group of sculpted white and gray clouds. Smaller vertical buildings and fine structures gather around its base. Near the right-hand water edge, a small boat with a warm yellow-orange hull and darker blue upper section provides a bright accent. The shoreline curves around an uneven rim of grass, exposed brown soil, and rock. Beneath this surface, the land contracts into a deep, pointed mass of dark teal-gray stone. Layered ledges, small cavities, hanging roots, and trailing greenery articulate its sides. Thin extensions hang below the lowest point and along the island edges. Small birds and isolated drifting fragments occupy the surrounding open space, while dense cloud forms rise behind the tower rather than filling the entire background. Soft directional light brightens the foliage, cloud tops, and upper ground, leaving the underside substantially darker. A faint diffuse shadow lies below and to the left on the otherwise plain field, reinforcing the hovering illusion. The composition balances the tall central tower with spreading greenery and the broad upper platform. Intricate miniature detail, warm natural accents, and a dark tapered base give the impossible landscape a tangible, quietly wondrous character.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅高度细致的超现实插画，一座漂浮岛屿呈现在浅灰米色背景前。岛面宽阔而近乎平整，覆盖绿植、小型建筑，前方横过一条蓝色水道。左侧大树从深色树干分枝，托起圆润树冠；右侧另有一组树木。两者之间，一座细长棱角高塔伸入成团白灰云中，塔基周围聚集较矮竖向建筑与精细结构。右侧近水边的小船带暖黄橙船身和较深蓝色上部，形成明亮点缀。岸线沿草丛、裸露棕土与岩石构成的不齐边缘弯曲。岛面以下，陆地收成深长尖锐的暗青灰岩体，层叠岩台、小凹穴、垂根和拖曳绿植刻画其侧面。细长延伸物悬在最低点和岛缘下方，零星鸟影与独立漂浮碎片分布于四周留白中；厚实云团集中升起在高塔背后，没有填满全部背景。柔和方向光照亮树叶、云顶和岛面，底部则明显深暗。下方偏左的素净色域中有一片淡淡漫散投影，强化悬浮错觉。构图以高耸中央塔平衡舒展绿植与宽阔岛面，细致微缩结构、自然暖色点缀和深暗尖锥底部共同赋予不可能的景象以可触、安静而奇妙的特征。
style_prompt_en: Highly detailed surreal rendering combines miniature precision with softly modeled atmospheric masses. The style combines a pale atmospheric field with layered forms that appear to float at different depths. Soft cool light fades gently across the background, while darker accents define suspended edges and narrow vertical elements. Small warm and green-blue touches punctuate a mostly neutral palette. Fine details remain concentrated near the central mass; outer space stays open and quiet. Uneven silhouettes, dangling extensions and scattered small marks create depth without a ground plane. The composition balances a tall central axis with lateral forms and leaves generous negative space. Its effect is airy and surreal, built from tonal separation, layered edges and suspended spatial relationships.
style_prompt_zh: 高度细致的超现实表现将微缩精度与柔和塑形的氛围体块结合。这种风格将浅淡氛围色域与仿佛悬浮在不同深度的层叠形体结合起来。柔和冷光在背景中渐渐消隐，深色点缀则勾出悬空边缘与细长竖向结构。少量暖色和蓝绿色为大体中性色谱添入亮点。精细细节集中在中央体量附近，外围空间保持开阔安静。不规则轮廓、向下延伸的形态和零散小标记在没有地面参照时仍能形成纵深。构图以中央竖轴平衡两侧形体，并保留充足负空间。整体效果轻盈而超现实，来自明暗分离、层叠边缘和悬置的空间关系。
theme_en: A tree-covered floating island with a slender city tower, waterway and small boat
theme_zh: 树木覆盖的漂浮岛屿，带细长城市高塔、水道和小船
name: Bottom view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
